text:
incident-bot: ALERT: unusual outgoing traffic from observability-indexer (high egress to external IP). Spike detected at 02:41 UTC. https://internal/alerts/6070012345 :rotating_light:
alex: on call, looking now. tagging @sec-oncall and @ops-runner
maria: FYI I see related S3 PUTs from the indexer in last 10m, small objects ~2-5KB each. not sure if PII.
sam: can you paste the log lines? any IPs or object keys?
alex: pasting sample lines:
```
2026-03-12T02:40:12Z indexer-3 PUT s3://obs-exports/2026/03/12/idx_ef23.log size=3587 src_ip=10.12.5.4 dst_ip=198.51.100.42
2026-03-12T02:40:14Z indexer-3 PUT s3://obs-exports/2026/03/12/idx_ef24.log size=4120 src_ip=10.12.5.4 dst_ip=198.51.100.42
```
sec-oncall: confirm I'm on it. first step: isolate the indexer and stop forwarder. alex, please scale down forwarder and revoke the exporter token.
alex: running:
```
kubectl -n observability scale deployment/logshipper --replicas=0
curl -X POST https://internal/auth/revoke -d '{"token":"svc-obs-forwarder-abc"}'
```
ops-runner: ack, starting S3 ACL / bucket version check + object quarantine. will snapshot keys list.
maria: tagging legal now @legal — need decision on customer notification if PII found. drafting initial incident timeline.
legal: thanks. hold on communication until we know scope. provide list of affected buckets, object names, and whether they contain request payloads.
sec-oncall: initial quick scan of samples: objects look like raw traces + headers. I see user-agent strings and truncated paths; no full auth headers in sample but we need full grep. running grep for "Authorization" and regexes for keys.
sam: small ask — rotate the indexer service account keys now as precaution. alex, can you rotate?
alex: rotating svcacct keys. command (GCP):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/new-key.json --iam-account indexer@prod.iam
# delete old key id: abcd-1234
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete abcd-1234 --iam-account indexer@prod.iam
```
sec-oncall: done with initial revoke of forwarder token. alex confirmed rotation started. ops-runner: quarantine copy of exposed objects to secure bucket and run content-scan (PII regexes + phone/email).
ops-runner: snapshot saved: s3://internal-quarantine/6070012345-snapshot/ ; running scan (ETA ~8m).
maria: preparing customer-impact matrix. currently no inbound tickets. tagging customer_success for watch.
legal: provide retention window and any deletion requests; if PII confirmed we need to notify within 72h (GDPR) — prepare timeline.
incident-bot: NOTE: pager acknowledged by alex and sec-oncall. Incident priority set to P1.
sec-oncall: scan result: out of 84 objects, 3 contain user emails and internal request ids. no auth tokens or full SSNs. marking sensitive = low/medium.
maria: thanks. proceeding with customer-impact draft listing potentially affected customer IDs (scrubbed) and mitigation steps. cc @customer-success.
alex: mitigation checklist updated in incident doc: https://internal/incidents/6070012345 — steps: isolate, revoke token, rotate svcacct keys, snapshot & quarantine, scan, legal review, customer-notify if required, rotate any exposed creds.
legal: approve notification template if PII confirmed; hold until final confirm.
sam: can we add IP block rule for 198.51.100.42 at the egress firewall to stop further exfil?
ops-runner: blocking now on egress ACLs and cloud firewall. applied rule: deny to 198.51.100.42 from observability subnet.
sec-oncall: confirm no more egress after block. logs show 00 attempts in last 2 mins.
maria: summarizing next steps in incident doc and will prepare brief for CSMs. asking ops to keep quarantine until legal clears.
alex: handing off to daytime oncall @sam for next 2h while I sleep. sam, status: forwarder revoked, svcacct rotate in progress, quarantine complete, egress blocked.
sam: taking over. I'll validate key rotation completed and kick off broader audit of other exporters.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1 -> active monitoring. last action by sam.
legal: request chain-of-custody notes for any objects shared with external tooling. ensure deletion of quarantine copies only after legal signoff.
ops-runner: acknowledged. will not purge quarantine until legal OK.
sec-oncall: recommendation: rotate any downstream ingestion tokens and add alert for unusual s3 PUTs > 1KB to external IPs.
maria: will add to runbook and Redwood Console alert rules.
alex: good work team. logging final notes and closing handoff.
